llm.summary: The skill is a coherent wrapper around JustOneAPI's Xiaohongshu (Pugongying) endpoints: it requires a single API token and the node binary and its instructions and code align with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the actual behavior: the package exposes ~25 GET endpoints for Xiaohongshu via JustOneAPI. Declared requirements (node, JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN) are appropriate and expected for calling that external API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to pick an appropriate GET operation, ask the user for missing parameters, and invoke the included CLI (bin/run.mjs) with the JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN. Instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files or exfiltrate data to unknown endpoints; all calls target api.justoneapi.com as declared.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (no remote downloads). A local Node script (bin/run.mjs) and generated OpenAPI files are included. Requiring the node binary is reasonable and low risk; nothing is fetched from arbitrary URLs or written to unexpected system locations in the provided manifests.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN is required (declared as primary credential). That token is proportional to the skill's purpose (authenticating to JustOneAPI). No unrelated secrets, config paths, or multiple credential requirements are present.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not claim elevated persistence or modify other skills. It can be invoked autonomously (platform default), which is expected for a service wrapper.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: call JustOneAPI to fetch Xiaohongshu creator data. Before installing, confirm you trust the JustOneAPI service (https://api.justoneapi.com) and only provide a token with the minimal necessary scope. Note the skill includes a local Node CLI (bin/run.mjs) that will make network requests to api.justoneapi.com; if you need stronger assurance, review the full run.mjs source for any unexpected network destinations or filesystem operations. Monitor usage/billing on your JustOneAPI account and rotate the token if you later remove the skill.
